bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (CPU Image, blur), springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (PNG/JPEG decode), springboard/render/src/glass.rs (material blur and saturation), springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs (photo filters, app-private), springboard/src/gpu/shaders.rs (GPU presenter shaders, not app-facing); springboard/render/src/feature_detect.rs, depth_blur.rs, color_curve.rs, photo_effects.rs, displacement_filters.rs, edge_tone_filters.rs (CPU models); springboard/sdk/src/image_filter.rs, image_blur.rs, image_effects.rs (app API)
summary: Core Image's lazy filter graph (CIContext, CIImage, CIKernel, render destinations) has no counterpart: BifrOSt runs filters eagerly on CPU images. The render crate has CPU models for colour adjustment, photo looks, blur, distortion, stylize, halftone, tile, bright-rectangle detection and depth blur, each with host unit tests. The SDK exposes them to apps as a filter chain, blur and image effects. Photos uses a few of them. None of this is verified on Midget yet, and the per-filter rows wait for the macOS 27 shader inventory where noted.

features.feature: Render destinations and video filtering (CIRenderDestination, CIImageAccumulator)
features.apple: CIRenderDestination, CIRenderTask, CIRenderInfo, CIImageAccumulator
features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/mod.rs (presenter for shell frames); springboard/src/gpu/filter_kernels.rs (GLSL generation, backend choice); springboard/render/src/render_destination.rs (Destination in 8-bit premultiplied, 8-bit straight or float premultiplied formats, sRGB tag, render_into with clipping, Accumulator with retain factor); springboard/sdk/src/image_render.rs (app API: Destination, render_into, Accumulator, render_to_destination, VideoFilter)
features.note: GPU path for the colour filters: CIColorMatrix, CIGammaAdjust and CISourceOverCompositing generate GLSL ES 3.00 with packed uniforms, a CPU reference evaluator and a Backend choice (CIContext useSoftwareRenderer). Pure model with host unit tests (written, not run); the GL dispatch and CIContext.render(_:to:) are not wired yet; not tested on Midget. Wave (theme-01, image filters round): the CPU destination (pixel format, alpha mode, colour space tag, clipped region copy) and the feedback accumulator (state kept across frames, source-over with a retain factor) are pure models with host unit tests, reachable from apps through bifrost_app::image_render. VideoFilter runs an app's FilterChain on each decoded frame, with optional feedback; an app feeds it the frames it gets from its own player. Gap: the shell's media player (springboard/src/media/player.rs take_frame) is not exposed to apps, Photo Booth and Photos video do not use VideoFilter yet, the GL dispatch is not wired, and nothing is verified on Midget.

features.note: Registry of the 56 built filters by reference name with category and input keys, filter_names(category) and attributes. Added 2026-10-17: the colour adjustment (exposure, gamma, vibrance, white point), colour effect (sepia, monochrome, posterize, false colour, invert), stylize (edges, highlight and shadow), generator (random, checkerboard, stripes), gradient (linear, radial) and transition (swipe, bars swipe, copy machine) entries. Input values are checked against their ranges by tests in filter_catalogue.rs. Gap: the catalogue is metadata; apps reach the named filter chain only for the eleven effects in effect_chain.rs. Added 2026-10-17: tile entries (triangle, parallelogram, perspective) and six transitions (flash, mod, page curl, ripple, accordion fold, disintegrate).

gaps: No lazy image graph: no CIImage or CIContext equivalent that defers and fuses filters; filters run eagerly on CPU images (lazy_image.rs is a model not yet used by the SDK).

No GPU render destination: the render destination and accumulator (springboard/render/src/render_destination.rs) are CPU models; the generated GPU colour shaders are not dispatched, and CIContext.render(_:to:) has no GPU counterpart.

No video filtering in apps' media pipeline: VideoFilter (sdk image_render) is an API for per-frame filtering, but the shell media player is not exposed to apps and Photo Booth and Photos video are not wired to it.
No custom kernel or custom filter extension point for apps (Core Image Kernel Language or Metal).
Colour: the temperature and tint model is a gain approximation, not a white-point conversion. Photos uses brightness and contrast only.
Feature detection covers axis-aligned bright rectangles only. No perspective quadrilaterals, faces, text, barcodes, or barcode and QR generation.
Depth blur needs an app-supplied depth map; there is no depth estimation from stereo or a single image, and no lens shape.
Tiles: the torus lens and circle splash profiles are approximate. Triangle, parallelogram and perspective tiles exist (tile_shapes.rs).
Photo looks approximate the reference tone curves; they are not exact.
Image input limited to JPEG and PNG. No RAW (CIRAWFilter), no HEIF, no colour-managed decoding path for apps.
The built-in filter catalogue lists 28 filters by name; the full reference catalogue is not covered.
Colour lookup: no SDK filter wraps the colour cube, colour map, Lab or palette models; apps cannot reach them.
